projects.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop in pure Rust
projects.readme_intro: PhotoCraft Image editing; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Photoshop, rebuilt in pure Rust. Layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors, brushes and real PSD files, in a native app written entirely in Rust. Open source, offline, and yours. PhotoCraft on getartcraft.com   · ArtCraft  · All Crafting Apps A caption card with a drop shadow, live type, and Vibrance
